reviews.text:
It was my first visit there today! I was absolutely delighted with the service I have received ( or should I say Ruby).
The place feels very welcoming and it’s not like any other places where that are trying to sell you lots of expensive services and products.
Please do check this place.
Ruby is going back there again this week, she is usually very nervous even at her local well known vet!
Super happy! Thank you
Great people and service! Take my dog Señor for nail clipping and teeth cleaning regularly, 100% recommend

I never do reviews, however reading the very few negative ones on here I felt I had to.
My puppy had his first groom here this morning and I  actually over the moon! They done what I wanted and more, the staff were extremely friendly and helpful. And my little pup looks and smells amazing, can’t honestly fault the place!

I love that they use their own organic, all-natural products. My pup has very sensitive skin, and other groomers often leave him itchy, but the oatmeal bath here worked wonders. Plus, the little bow they added to his collar was the cutest touch.
Great with our dogs and their grooms were fantastic
Great service, kind people, and our cardigan corgi always looks great at pickup!

I've only taken my dog Archie to this groomers a few times, but I will definitely keep taking him there and nowhere else.
The whole experience from the moment you take your dog in to the moment of picking him up is exceptional service. If I could I would give it 10 gold stars.
I 💯% recommend.
Thank you sniffles.
Friendly staff who make you feel welcome and safe to leave your pup!
Great teeth cleaning! Dropped off my dog for 30 mins and came back and his fangs were pearly white and plaque free.

I had my dog groomed here, and I couldn’t be happier with the results! Bella always comes in wagging her tail and leaves looking and feeling amazing. The staff is professional, and truly the best groomers in the area. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for top-quality grooming.

My jack Russell is now very old and frail and I cannot recommend this groomers highly enough .
They made my dog at ease with care and attention while washing him and clipping his nails .
He is happy to go in every time .
Really happy I found sniffles .
Highly recommend.

From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the level of professionalism and care. The grooming services were exceptional, carried out with real attention to detail and expertise. What stood out most was the atmosphere created by the staff — warm, welcoming, and genuinely kind. They made the entire experience comfortable and enjoyable, which is not always easy to find. This is truly a place where excellent service meets outstanding hospitality, and I would not hesitate to recommend it to anyone seeking top-quality grooming.
Nice Groomers and shop keeper
Excellent grooming with outstanding service — every staff member was so nice.

Before a groom and after!
Thank you to the best grooming salon ever! I’m so impressed. My Chesko looks so handsome! Good job on the tear stains, his eyes look so clean! And his ears are so clean too. I’m so grateful 🩷 …

Don’t let the negative reviews fool you — a lot of that noise is just jealousy, plain and simple. Sniffles has been taking care of dogs in our community for the past 15 years, and their consistent service, love for animals, and attention to detail speak louder than any unfair criticism ever could.

This is the only place I trust for both grooming and daycare. The team treats every dog like their own, and you can tell they truly care about your pet’s well-being.

Hugo has just had his teeth ultrasonically cleaned. I’m wildly impressed. Seriously be good result you have to see the pictures! He will come back later for some maintenance and it’s a very happy atmosphere for the dogs here

Staff are always so lovely and always offer tips and tricks for grooming at home, especially Anna, one of the receptionist’s. Sae is my go to girl for grooming my toy poodle, Winston. She gets his cut perfect every time!!

A wonderful groom experience for my dog Buddy. His groom looks extremely professional and due to the cutting skill, he doesn’t get tangles between each groom. He really loves his grooming sessions but also his teeth being sonically  cleaned whilst he’s there! Can’t recommend highly enough. An overall great experience.
Local groomers who did not disappoint. Friendly and quality service. Would definitely recommend
Thank you

I have been going to Sniffles for 10 years or more with Foxy- Lady.Every time she's groomed she looks like a puppy she's 12. I've never had to complain once,her cut is always perfect. The staff are so friendly and welcoming Ana greets us by name with a big welcoming smile. Ines and Sae the groomers are very professional. I highly recommend Sniffles Dog Grooming Spa
Absolutely love the place!

I have been taking my Shih Tzu to Sniffles for a full groom for 3 years, and I can’t recommend this place enough.

Ana the manager is so lovely and always greets us with happiness and kindness.

Ines is Lolla’s go-to groomer; Lolla loves her and is always happy before and after. She knows exactly how to shape Lolla’s fur.

Today we met Sai, the new groomer, and she was amazing! Lolla was so happy and looked beautiful.

Thank you guys so much for always being lovely with us!.
Thank you Kevin🙏🙏 …

We have been using this grooming service for the past three years, and during that time, they have gotten to know our dog, Archie, who is a Yorkie. Archie has always been terrified of groomers, and we would consistently warn them that he …

Angel was an absolute delight! Our puppy Bruno actually enjoyed his time at the groomer (who thought that would be a thing!!) Angel did a beautiful groom and now he is so much cooler for summer! Thank you so much x
